title: Fill step pitch 3.0 mm: row stitches of that length
description: A 40 × 40 mm fill at 0°, step pitch 2 mm: the row stitches are 2 mm and the grid moves 30 % of a stitch per row, as in PE-DESIGN's file.

evidence.note: Fill Stitch: Direction, Density, Step pitch, Frequency

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page (grid 1 mm, Snap to Grid) draw a 40 × 40 mm square from (10, 10) to (50, 50) mm with the Rectangle tool. Line Not Sewn; colour 800 RED; region sew type Fill Stitch, Direction Manual 0°, Step pitch 2 mm, Under sewing unticked, every other region attribute at PE-DESIGN's default (Density 4.5, Step pitch 4.0 mm, Frequency 30 %, Pull compensation 0.0 mm, Feathered edge and Gradation off). Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: most stitches are row stitches of the step pitch

PE-DESIGN 11.50's file, needle point for needle point (±0.15 mm, mean nearest-needle distance 0.00 mm): the row structure of sweep-fill-pitch-2p0 at step pitch 3.0 mm. Counts within 1 %: PE keeps a grid point at exactly 0.3 mm from a row end on a few rows (8 of 2604 needle points differ, stitch-rules handover F4), so the stream is not compared entry by entry.
